moves.title: The Reel is cut to 45 seconds
moves.why: The first Reel reached 19 people and they watched twelve seconds of 116. A 45-second cut, the feature and one thing a day, gives Instagram something people finish.
moves.plan: From Wed Oct 21 the Reel is the feature and one thing a day, Thursday to Sunday, in 45 seconds; the intro says the rest are at soknoear.com. Say don't and it stays the full cut.

moves.title: Tag the artist in the picture too
moves.why: You said go, but Wednesday tagged only venues: the draft never named an act. The draft is refused until every story names its act or says there's none.
moves.plan: Wednesday's posts tagged nobody but venues: the draft never carried an act. From the No. 19 draft (Tue Oct 20) every story names its act's handle or says there is none, or the draft is refused. Say don't and it is the venue alone.

done.title: Eighteen of eighteen posted, no retries.
done.text: The most in a week again. The ad is off until you say otherwise. First notes went to The 808 and Hi-Wire on Wednesday.

done.title: The first Reel went out Wednesday at one.
done.text: 116 seconds, 18 stories. It reached 19 people. The 45-second cut above is the fix; the voice lines are already paid for.

done.title: No. 17 kept growing.
done.text: 926 last Monday, 1,093 now. A loud week lifts the posts behind it; followers who saw a post went from 23% to 24%.

done.title: The roundup read 68, its best.
done.text: It read 14 and 32 before. Five profile visits and one follow came from it. Still no saves, from anyone, ever.
